title: Jev Comment Triage: comments and bbPress forums
summary: How comments, topics, and replies (new or edited) are held, assessed asynchronously, and routed without overriding WordPress or bbPress moderation. Working tree on top of d79dfbe.

flows.title: Eligible comment submission
flows.summary: An eligible comment is held and queued; the submission request makes no Jev call.

flows.title: Background assessment succeeds
flows.summary: The normal Jev path for comments, topics, and replies, when no rule or enabled cache hit takes a shortcut.

flows.title: Retries after provider outages
flows.summary: First and third failures are shown; the second also stays pending for a later drain.

flows.title: Rejected request is split
flows.summary: Example: a two-comment request is rejected, the first succeeds alone, and the second is rejected alone.

flows.title: Forum topic or reply submission
flows.summary: A new topic or reply is held as pending and queued; the request makes no Jev call.

flows.title: Edited comment is triaged again
flows.summary: Changed content from an untrusted editor is held and queued again; the base cannot rise.

flows.title: Forum decision is applied
flows.summary: Decisions go through bbPress moderation functions; automated spam is not reported to Akismet.

views.title: System overview
views.summary: How WordPress, bbPress, triage, the provider, and Jev interact.

views.title: Decision policy
views.summary: Default thresholds; the base decision limits publication.
